title: Sirf 65 MB ka AI voice model, bina internet ke #shorts
description:
AI news: Gradium ka Phonon, ek chhota text-to-speech model jo aapke apne device par chalta hai, bina server ya network ke. Size lagbhag 65 MB aur 75 MB, 100 se zyada built-in voices, English, French, German, Spanish aur Portuguese. Pehle 2 hafte me 2,00,000 se zyada download. Dhyan rahe: page me Hindi ka zikr nahi hai; Phonon 31m (English) Apache 2.0 hai, baaki models CC BY-NC (non-commercial).

Source (official blog post):
https://huggingface.co/blog/phonon-tts

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Gradium or Hugging Face.

Note: blog crops are our own capture of the page (key lines highlighted). Photos are free AI-generated illustrations, not real product shots. Synthetic voice.

Music: "Funkorama" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
